_comment: The Isle's built-in third-party DATAPACKS, pinned by version AND sha1. build.gradle downloads each one, refuses any other bytes, and unpacks it unmodified into the jar's datapacks/<folder>/. The licence line is what was READ out of each zip's own LICENSE file (MIT, (c) 2024 BPR02), not what Modrinth's metadata says; every zip carries that LICENSE inside it, and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt carries it again. Adding a pack: read its LICENSE first, then add a row with every field.

standard-skyblock.title: SkyBlock - Standard (Standard SkyBlock)
standard-skyblock.author: BluePsychoRanger (BPR02)
standard-skyblock.does: void world generation (every structure's bounding box, no blocks) and the starter island at world spawn, placed when the first player joins (skyvoid_worldgen:v2.0/load_wait waits for @a)

sky-void-additions.title: Sky Void Additions
sky-void-additions.author: BluePsychoRanger (BPR02)
sky-void-additions.does: vanilla-like mechanics that make every item, mob and advancement obtainable in SkyBlock; each toggleable (/function skyvoid_additions:customize/update_config/open_menu)

skyblock-advancements.title: SkyBlock Advancements
skyblock-advancements.author: EpyonProjects (the pack's own credit); the LICENSE inside the zip reads BPR02
skyblock-advancements.does: the story and nether advancement tabs rearranged for SkyBlock progression, plus new ones (skyvoid_advancements:overworld/*). Its optional RESOURCE pack (rp_skyvoid_advancements_*.zip) is deliberately not fetched: the level offers no resource pack
